sources.title: Ultimate Yu Garden Shanghai Guide (2026): Things to See, Do & Eat
sources.content:
Yu Garden is a classical Ming Dynasty garden over 450 years old, spanning 30+ acres in Shanghai's Huangpu District. Address: 168 Fangyou Road. Hours: 9:00 AM–4:30 PM (last entry 4:00 PM); closed Mondays except holidays. Visit Duration: Approximately 1 hour.

Tickets: Peak (Apr-Jun, Sep-Nov) Adult ¥40, Children ¥20, Seniors ¥20. Off-Peak (Jul-Aug, Dec-Mar) ¥30/¥15/¥15. Children under 6 or 1.3m free.

Major Attractions: Huxinting Teahouse (Shanghai's First Teahouse via nine-bend bridge), Sansui Hall (northeast with prosperity sculptures), Wanhua Tower (Eight Immortals sculptures), Dianchun Hall (intricate Ming-Qing carvings).

Local Foods: Five-Spice Beans, Pear Syrup Candy, Butterfly Pastries, White Rabbit Candy, Four-Treasure Kao Fu.

Metro: Line 10 to Yu Garden Station (Exit 1). Bus: Routes 930, 64. Strollers can be challenging due to narrow paths; baby carriers recommended. Photography permitted; drones prohibited.

Performance Schedule: Light Show 18:30-21:00 (every 30 minutes), Hanfu Performances 18:30-20:00.

Stamp Collection: Scan QR codes at eight locations to collect stamps and receive exclusive merchandise.

sources.title: Shanghai's Yu Garden: Highlights, Tips & Things to Do
sources.content:
Built in the Ming Dynasty by Pan Yunduan as a retirement gift for his father, the garden's name means peace and joy.

Grand Rockery: Massive rockery designed by famous Ming Dynasty rock artist Zhang Nanyang, made of thousands of tons of yellow stone.

Exquisite Jade Rock: Rare Taihu stone, one of the Three Famous Stones of Jiangnan.

Dragon Walls: Five decorative walls dividing garden spaces. Iron Lions cast in Yuan Dynasty. Wan Hua Lou has beautifully carved windows depicting the Four Gentlemen.

Hours: 09:00-16:30, closed Mondays. Admission: Adults 40 RMB peak, 30 RMB off-season.

Spring offers vibrant blooms. Autumn provides ideal weather and fall foliage. Winter features magical Lantern Festival during Chinese New Year.

Plan 1-1.5 hours. Nearby: City God Temple (closes 4:30 PM, 10 RMB), Nine Bend Bridge night views.

Must-try: Nanxiang Steamed Buns, crab roe noodles, pork ribs with rice cakes.

sources.title: Yu Garden Shanghai (2026): Practical Survival Guide
sources.content:
Yu Garden, located in Shanghai's historic Old City, is one of the finest surviving examples of classical Chinese garden design in eastern China, constructed in 1559 during the Ming Dynasty by government official Pan Yunduan.

Open Tuesday-Sunday 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM. Peak season (April 1-June 30, September 1-November 30): CNY 40. Off-peak: CNY 30.

Visit on a weekday morning for serene photos. Spring (March-May) is classic with magnolias and cherry blossoms.

The Jade Rock (Yulinglong Stone) is one of the most treasured sights, one of the top three famous rocks in Jiangnan. The Nine-Bend Bridge outside the garden is free, iconic.

Yuyuan Lantern Festival 2026 themed around the zodiac horse, lasting 36 days from January 26th to March 3rd.

Wear comfortable shoes. Consider wearing Hanfu for photography. Souvenir prices in Yuyuan Bazaar are 2-3x higher than normal.

sources.title: Yu Garden Shanghai: Yuyuan Garden, Bazaar & Opening Hours (2026 Guide)
sources.content:
Yu Garden is one of Shanghai's must-visit landmarks, a classical Chinese garden with over 450 years of history. The garden features pavilions, ponds, rockeries, and traditional architecture.

Opening hours: Tuesday to Sunday, 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM (last admission 4:00 PM). Closed on Mondays.

The surrounding Yuyuan Bazaar is a bustling marketplace with traditional snacks, souvenirs, and cultural performances.

sources.title: 豫园_百度百科
sources.content:
豫园位于上海市黄浦区福佑路168号，始建于明代嘉靖、万历年间，已有450余年历史，占地30余亩。与露香园、日涉园合称为明朝上海三大名园，名列现存上海五大古典名园之首，国家AAAA级旅游景区。

园主潘允端为让父亲安享晚年，经过20余年苦心经营建成豫园。明万历十八年（1590年）园成时占地70余亩，后历经战乱衰败。1949年后政府修复，1982年被公布为第二批全国重点文物保护单位。

采用自然式布局，即幽深曲折的设计理念。包含大假山、玉玲珑、荷花池等主要景观，以及三穗堂、万花楼、点春堂等建筑群。

湖心亭被誉为海上第一茶楼。大假山由叠石大家张南阳设计。玉玲珑是江南三大名石之一，具皱、漏、透、瘦特点。

开放时间：9:00-16:30，周一闭园。门票：旺季40元，淡季30元。交通：地铁10号线或公交980、930、736、24、11路等。

sources.title: Yu Garden, Shanghai Yuyuan Garden Opening Hours, Ticket
sources.content:
Yu Garden is one of the finest surviving examples of classical Chinese garden design. Originally constructed in 1559 by Pan Yunduan. The name means Garden of Peace and Comfort.

Open Tuesday-Sunday, 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM. Peak season admission 40 CNY, off-peak 30 CNY.

Highlights include the Grand Rockery, Exquisite Jade Rock, Huxinting Teahouse (across the Nine Zigzag Bridge), and the Inner Garden with its Phoenix Pavilion.

The surrounding Yuyuan Tourist Mart is a large bazaar featuring traditional Chinese architecture, local snacks, and souvenir shopping.
